title: pinus ponderosa subsp. benthamiana
intro: Pinus ponderosa subsp. benthamiana, commonly known as the Ponderosa Pine, is a subspecies of pine tree native to the southwestern United States and northern Mexico. The health benefits of Pinus ponderosa subsp. benthamiana include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory health due to its antimicrobial and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use as an expectorant to relieve coughs and its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory to soothe skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of Pinus ponderosa subsp. benthamiana include terpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
